source: Exact release subject manifest, CycloneDX SBOM, registry resolution and GitHub/Sigstore attestation bytes for one repository commit.
control: Bind the closed subject-name set, immutable image digests, manifest SHA-256, SBOM SHA-256 and cryptographic attestation verification into one artifact receipt; reject missing, substituted, extra or self-asserted evidence.
sink: Artifact-verification receipt consumed by trusted deployment admission and release evidence.

pre_fix_negative.observation: Release evidence could report SBOM/provenance success without an exact subject-manifest and artifact-receipt binding.

negative: wrong subject, digest, manifest hash, SBOM hash and unverified provenance reject
hostile: extra subjects and normalized boolean reports cannot authorize deployment

external_conditions: EXTERNAL-PENDING: fetch and verify the real GitHub/Sigstore attestations for the exact release subjects.
EXTERNAL-PENDING: trusted external deployment-admission producer must authenticate and approve the exact artifact receipt.
rollback: Revert cohort/support commits and keep the release blocked; never fall back to unsigned or self-asserted provenance.

regression: SSH host-key suite 22/22; deploy input suite 20/20
consumer: deploy-vps.sh and evidence workflows consume the exact approved known-host input
hostile: no ssh-keyscan or StrictHostKeyChecking bypass is accepted

EXTERNAL-PENDING: first real SSH connection must verify the exact approved endpoint and preserve an out-of-band recovery path.
